findings.title: Headless Service maps a port it cannot map
findings.cause: Service peers is headless (clusterIP: None) and maps port 80 to targetPort 8080 (8080), but a headless Service has no proxy: its name resolves to the pods' own addresses, so a client that dials port 80 reaches the pods on port 80, where they do not listen; only SRV lookups return port 8080

evidence.what: Service peers has clusterIP None, port 80 and targetPort 8080
evidence.command: kubectl get service peers -n kd-headless-port-remap -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}{" "}{.spec.ports}'

findings.fix: Make port equal the port the pods listen on (port: 8080) so clients dial that, or give the Service a cluster IP (remove clusterIP: None, which takes recreating it) if clients need port 80 mapped.
